```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<blockquote><p>First paragraph.</p><p>Second paragraph.</p></blockquote>", ConversionOptions())
    println(result)
}
```
